speaker.name: Requirements Reuben
speaker.role: Architects secure and scalable production ML systems. Defines security requirements, ensures privacy compliance, and manages data governance. Conducts rigorous testing and validation to guarantee high product quality.

output.objection: I did not ask for the pipeline to run on its own, I asked for the handovers to be automated to enforce data integrity. You are conflating operational speed with the security controls I need to see.
output.correction: This is a governance requirement, not an automation one. I need formal sign off on the risk to acceptance hand over and the acceptance to evaluation hand over, not just a tool that moves data without a human check.
